scope: Full builds, N3 alternating old(a)/new(b) TaskGroup2 and old(d)/new(e) serial split. Same frozen corpus; isolated guest parsed-source cache per cold/warm pair, native JIT cache primed, all other guest caches off. Process-tree RSS summed every25ms (shared pages can be counted twice). No concurrent builds/tests/edits. Service worker_ms now includes parent encode/decode/merge; do not compare this phase directly to old worker_ms.

limitations: Cold summed process-tree RSS increases by 27.0% for compiler and 13.0% for CLI.
TaskGroup 2 remains slower than serial split; this is an opt-in structural improvement, not a default build speedup.
RSS is sampled every 25 ms and shared mappings may be counted more than once; this is not allocation volume.
Candidate worker_ms includes parent encoding, decoding and merging, unlike baseline worker_ms.
